eligible_actor: municipality / regional government / public services (projects via SNI-BIP)
amount_note: large regional investment projects; per-project, requires SNI 'Recomendación Satisfactoria (RS)'
climate_relevance: climate-adjacent (funds any regional infrastructure incl. climate works)
notes: Regional tier. The main regional investment channel (created 1974). Broad: down-weight in scoring (capped at Moderate).

program: FRIL — Fondo Regional de Iniciativa Local
amount_note: minor communal infrastructure, total project cost <= M$180,000 (~CLP 180,000,000)
climate_relevance: climate-adjacent (minor municipal infrastructure for vulnerable areas)
notes: Regional tier. Municipal small-works fund; very city-accessible but broad (capped at Moderate).

program: FNDR 8% — Subvención a actividades (línea Medio Ambiente y educación ambiental)
eligible_actor: non-profit organisations (legal status >=2 yrs; NOT municipalities)
amount_note: up to ~CLP 30,000,000; max 2 projects per org; activities up to 6 months (Jul-Dec 2026)
notes: Regional tier. Structured nationally by Ley de Presupuestos glosa 07; same line across GOREs. Actor = NGOs, not the municipality; activities not infrastructure.

program: FRPD — Fondo Regional para la Productividad y el Desarrollo
eligible_actor: legal persons / firms / institutions (productive investment; varies by region)
amount_note: per-region; e.g. up to ~CLP 300,000,000 (Arica y Parinacota 2026)
climate_relevance: climate-adjacent (productive investment; may fund clean-tech / EE)
notes: Regional tier. Productivity/investment fund; climate relevance depends on the funded project. Confirm per-region call.
